name: AROS Group - Luxury Packaging
old_description: At AROS Group (Formerly JUJIN NY), every packaging piece is a surface of expression, designed to speak without words.
about:
AROS Group, formerly known as JUJIN NY, operates as a luxury packaging manufacturer headquartered in New York, New York. The company maintains a global presence with offices in Paris, Milan, London, Dubai, Shenzhen, Shanghai, São Paulo, Mexico City, and Singapore, and describes its manufacturing footprint as an integrated network of factories spanning Paris, Shanghai, Milan, and New York. No founding year, ownership structure, or founders are disclosed in the available information.

The company designs and produces multi-material luxury packaging for sectors including fragrance, beauty, spirits and beverages, fashion and accessories, watches and jewelry, haute gastronomy, technology and smart living, and corporate gifting. Its capabilities cover the full lifecycle from concept and prototyping through manufacturing and supply chain coordination, working with materials such as paper, board, fabric, wood, plastics, metal, glass, and composites. AROS Group states it handles both small series and mass production, orchestrating projects through a six-phase process it calls Intuition, Creation, Materialization, Development, Excellence, and Realization.

Clients are primarily luxury brands seeking complete packaging ecosystems — glass bottles, caps, boxes, cases, and accessories — that extend brand rituals. The company cites work across fragrance cases, beauty packaging ecosystems, spirits ceremonial packaging, fashion boxes and displays, watch and jewelry cases, gastronomy packaging, technology packaging, and corporate gifting objects.

AROS Group emphasizes precision engineering, sustainability-driven decisions powered by AI and data, and a global manufacturing network that ensures consistency. It highlights Ecovadis recognition for responsible processes and certified materials, positioning luxury as a harmony with the planet rather than a compromise.
